rules.material: Hand-painted parchment, warm wood and aged brass, visible restrained brush texture.
rules.shape: Sturdy panel frames, softly bevelled rectangular buttons and coherent corner ornaments.
rules.typography: Readable fantasy serif titles and quiet body lettering; preserve exact requested copy.
rules.icons: Painted pictograms with readable silhouettes and restrained warm outlines.
rules.decoration: Moderate ornaments at structural corners; keep controls and text clear.
rules.lighting: Warm upper-left highlights, shallow bevels and soft ambient shadows.
